LESSON: WRITING 6.5.1 COMMONLY MISSPELT WORDS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.5: Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How can we improve our spelling?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. recognise commonly misspelt words in texts
2. use commonly misspelt words correctly in written texts
3. value the relationship between accurate spelling and effective written communication

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: WRITING 6.5.1 COMMONLY MISSPELT WORDS
This lesson teaches Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words for Grade 7 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. recognise commonly misspelt words in texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use commonly misspelt words correctly in written texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. value the relationship between accurate spelling and effective written communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words above.
2. Explain Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Writing 6.5.1 Commonly Misspelt Words important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can we improve our spelling?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. recognise commonly misspelt words in texts
2. use commonly misspelt words correctly in written texts
3. value the relationship between accurate spelling and effective written communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
